sections.Profile:
Round Up , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in July 1971, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring artwork by Christian Marche. This two-player game has a Western and dancing theme, with a simple, single-level playfield design and mechanical reel scoring.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Editions: - Round Up: 70 made, released 1971-07-01, model number 923
